messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 1.5.2

1.5.2. Static electricity Machinery must be designed and constructed to prevent or limit the build-up of potentially dangerous electrostatic charges and/or be fitted with a discharging system.

response.text:
Machinery | mustBeDesignedToPreventOrLimit | build-up of potentially dangerous electrostatic charges | | Machinery must be designed and constructed to prevent or limit the build-up of potentially dangerous electrostatic charges
Machinery | mustBeFittedWith | a discharging system | as an alternative or addition to design measures (and/or) | be fitted with a discharging system
